correctness.rationale: All orbits of flags are represented bijectively by sorted nonempty column-type multisets carrying row and birth-stage labels. Correct quotient boundary maps are implemented by stage merging/deletion, and exhaustive GF2 elimination with d^2=0 gives Betti vector (1,0,0,0,0,1) for n=4,5,6; no face can meet more than six columns, so the complete orbit chain model is unchanged for n>=6. Jojić et al. Theorem 6.1 gives 4-connectivity of the cover at n>=4; Armstrong gives trivial quotient pi1 since all generating column transpositions fix vertices. Finite CW, UCT, localized Hurewicz and Whitehead yield the claimed 2-local S5. The attached verify.py and its output were run in the extracted standalone package path; finite computation is exhaustive within the bounded parameter reduction, not an attempted proof by sampling.

originality.rationale: The 2026-10-18 same-family cyclic quotient theorem studies C_n, not S_n and does not calculate the nonfree full-symmetric quotient mod-two homology. Reiner-Roberts representation theory covers characteristic-zero representations of the covering complexes, not quotient chains in characteristic two with stabilizers. The three-row wedge theorem treats covers. published-finding corpus exact-object, alias, stronger coverage and quotient searches (listed below) returned no dominating theorem. Residual risk includes unindexed geometric invariant theory or unpublished quotient computations.

value.rationale: This resolves the prime-two homotopy type of a natural nonfree geometric orbit quotient in every width, while the covering complexes have very large varying fifth Betti rank and their cyclic quotients carry genuine integral torsion. The six-column saturation reduces an infinite quotient family to three exact finite orbit-chain computations, giving a reusable method for stabilizer-sensitive symmetric simplicial quotients. It is not merely a renaming of a rational representation, a routine connectivity assertion, or a single small finite check.
